dimensions.label: Overall
dimensions.blurb: Segment-, frame- and IoU-level F1 on both halves of the benchmark, averaged over the temporal tolerance sweep.

dimensions.label: Public data
dimensions.blurb: Six re-annotated public datasets: RAI, BBC, AutoShot, ClipShots, MovieShots-2, SportsShot.

dimensions.label: Synthetic data
dimensions.blurb: Videos built by the FFmpeg data engine, where every transition has an exact segment-level label by construction.

dimensions.label: Per-τ
dimensions.blurb: Every method at each temporal tolerance τ, per dataset — 168 tables and 98 curves, generated with the paper.

dimensions.label: Per transition type
dimensions.blurb: Seg-F1 split by transition family on the synthetic half, at Δtt = 0. The none column is 1k single-shot negatives: every method scoring 0 is the sanity check, not a failure.

dimensions.label: Per duration class
dimensions.blurb: Seg-F1 by transition duration. SBD methods emit ~0.04 s segments that all land in the cut bin, so their normal/long precision of 1.0 is an artefact — compare F1.

dimensions.label: IoU τ-sweep
dimensions.blurb: TAL-style strict matching (Δtt = 0, no boundary dilation), following ActionFormer / THUMOS / ActivityNet. F1@1.0 is 0 for everyone by construction — IoU > 1 is impossible, which is what makes it a valid lower bound.

dimensions.label: Efficiency
dimensions.blurb: Parameter count against real-time factor. The paper’s Table 3 reports RTF model-forward-only for every method so the numbers stay comparable across papers; this view adds the optical-flow pass and the end-to-end total.
footnotes: Params here is the tied-weight count (≈ 4.4 B). The Overall view reports 4.8 B, the raw checkpoint, whose extra 390 M is lm_head materialised as a byte-identical copy of embed_tokens. The 6-channel patch-embed extension adds under 1 M parameters and no new modules.

RTF (VLM) is the model forward only — the convention every row of Table 3 uses, decode excluded for all methods alike. RTF (end-to-end) adds the NeuFlow optical-flow pass. Both are shown because only one of them is comparable across papers and only the other one is what you wait for.

dimensions.label: JSON reliability
dimensions.blurb: Every VLM asked for the same JSON schema, put through the same repair pipeline. Denominators are per query, which is the conservative choice for a sliding-window method issuing ~8× more queries per video. A valid empty list is a prediction, not a failure, and is not counted as one.

dimensions.label: Ablations
dimensions.blurb: Each component removed in turn, everything else held fixed.
